name: dev-ai-tools
description: Project-agnostic Claude Code plugins that improve the developer experience when working with AI coding agents. Companion to the CLI bundle installed by `make setup`.

plugins.name: deep-review
plugins.description: Adversarial, lens-driven code review. Fans out finders across configurable lenses (correctness, design, performance, security, tenancy, governance, conventions, blast-radius), verifies every candidate by refutation, checks the change against the codebase's existing patterns, and delivers ranked findings as inline PR comments.

plugins.name: practices
plugins.description: Working habits that decide whether an agent's output is trustworthy: verify before asserting, gates that must be observed failing, an autonomy contract, destructive-action safety, and visual iteration that doesn't burn rounds. Each written after the failure it prevents actually happened.
